title: Basin spectrum (kurtosis + Zipf slope) bypasses KL dead-zone for F-PERSONA-4 winner-take-all distinction
question: Can basin-rank diversity (rank-frequency spectrum + Zipfian fit) distinguish balanced / differentiated / collapsed expert-routing scenarios where KL(routing || uniform) alone fails?

anchor.h_title: attractor basin size vs dominance rank
anchor.porting_target: F-PERSONA-4 (anima v5-mitosis cotrain v1) — KL=0 winner-take-all measurement ambiguity

engine: pure hexa-lang. 8 experts, 1000 tokens per scenario, deterministic LCG seed=42, inverse-CDF top-1 sampling.
runtime: $0 Mac-local, deterministic byte-identical (verified by re-run diff).

A_balanced.intent: current cotrain v1 result — uniform routing, KL≈0

joint_basin_spectrum_distance.note: Euclidean in (kurtosis, zipf_slope). All pairwise > 0.3 threshold.

falsifier_eval.F-BRD-2_joint_basin_spectrum_distinguish: PASS — d(A,B)=2.77, d(B,C)=5.46, d(A,C)=3.45 (all > 0.3). NOTE: zipf_slope alone is degenerate on C (n_nonzero=1 → slope=0.0) and indistinguishable from A's near-zero slope; the joint spectrum is the correct measurement.
falsifier_eval.F-BRD-3_KL_dead_zone_bypassed: PASS — KL(A)=0.0033 ≈ 0 (within 0.05), yet |kurtosis(A) - kurtosis(C)| = 3.45 ≫ 1.0. The basin spectrum sees structure that KL alone misses on the balanced side.

verdict_derived: 🟢 PASS — basin spectrum (basin_kurtosis as primary, joint (kurtosis, zipf_slope) as fallback when single-rank degeneracy hits) correctly distinguishes balanced / differentiated / collapsed routing distributions. KL_to_uniform fails to separate the balanced case (KL=0.003) from a no-information null — basin_kurtosis(A)=-0.30 separates it from collapsed (kurtosis=+3.14) by 3.44 units. This validates basin-rank diversity as a KL-dead-zone bypass measurement for F-PERSONA-4 (anima v5-mitosis cotrain v1, KL=0 mean_KL winner-take-all). Adoption path: replace mean_KL gate with basin_kurtosis or joint (kurt, zipf) gate for cotrain re-measure.
structural_vs_dynamical: MEASUREMENT kernel. The finding is not about anima dynamics but about which measure-of-distribution captures the right signal. KL is sensitive to mass differences from a reference (uniform); basin spectrum is sensitive to the *shape* of the rank-frequency curve regardless of which expert dominates.
honest_limits: n_experts=8; for n_experts=2 (the exact F-PERSONA-4 cell count) the spectrum collapses to a single pair and basin_kurtosis is mathematically constrained. Real anima cotrain has 2-64 cells; the diagnostic value rises with cell count.
1000 tokens — KL_A has sampling noise (0.003 nats); with N→∞ KL_A → 0 exactly, leaving KL_B and KL_C indistinguishable from the dead-zone problem we already identified.
Zipf_slope alone is degenerate for C (single-rank attractor). The joint spectrum sidesteps this; a single-scalar replacement gate should be basin_kurtosis (excess kurtosis), not zipf_slope.

Synthetic gates — real cotrain dynamics may produce intermediate spectra not modeled here (e.g., bimodal, heavy-tailed). The bench is a CONTROLLED proof that the measurement can discriminate, not a forecast of the anima ckpt's actual basin shape.
Threshold 0.3 is heuristic — calibrate against H100 cotrain v1 ckpt re-measure before locking the gate.

anima_application.current_failure: cotrain v1 yields mean_KL = 0.0 (cell 0 weight=1.0 every category) — FAIL but provides no signal whether the failure is mode-collapse or category-prompt invariance
anima_application.proposed_replacement: basin_kurtosis(per-category top-1 expert frequency) — separates 'all routed to same expert' (high positive kurtosis, single basin) from 'evenly spread' (negative kurtosis, no basin)
anima_application.expected_signal: v5-mitosis cotrain v1 likely has basin_kurtosis ≈ 3.14 (single-cell winner) → diagnoses mode-collapse, distinct from category-invariance (which would give kurtosis ≈ -3 across categories)

discovery_note: H_338 의 attractor basin = dominance rank 통찰을 routing distribution 의 winner-take-all 진단에 포팅. KL=0 dead-zone 의 우회 측정자로 basin spectrum (excess kurtosis primary, joint with Zipf slope) 입증. F-PERSONA-4 의 'KL=0 = 정보 0' 가짜 동치 깨짐.
